title: FlowMirror run configuration
description: Configuration for one simulation run. Defaults live in config/engine_defaults.yaml. Modality may be assigned per agent, run, or exposure; optional local images are digest-verified before use. Mock-only fields are accepted only when mock_llm is true. CLI runtime switches such as --dump-prompt are intentionally not schema keys, and unknown keys are rejected except for metadata keys beginning with an underscore.

mock_llm.description: When true, mock_options becomes required (see allOf).

agent_policy.description: Decision source for every agent: 'llm' (live/mock caller) or 'null' (flowmirror.agents.null_policy.NullPolicyLLM; wins over mock_llm). Fix null_params before comparing run results.

null_params.description: Rule parameters for the null policy; all scalar keys are numbers and stance_probs carries the three stance probabilities. Defaults live in config/engine_defaults.yaml.

strategy_mix.description: Named mix, or explicit I1/I2/I3 weights summing to ~1.

arm_level.description: LEGACY, optional: alias for modality_level from the pre-modality-arm era (world.py maps it when modality_level is absent). No longer required.

modality_level.description: Assignment level for modality arms; arm_level is the legacy alias used when this key is absent.

modality_arms.description: Non-empty unique subset of {T, TC, TV}.

modality_run_arm.description: Arm applied to every agent when modality_level == 'run'; must appear in modality_arms.

images_root.description: Optional local directory holding pre-resized creative images, one file per image_id from the content pool. The engine verifies each file's sha256 before attaching pixels on the TV arm; a missing file or hash mismatch attaches nothing and records a prompt note. null means text-only and skips the image-carrying invariant. Images must remain outside the repository.

image_pick.description: Which of a note's own images is displayed on the TV arm: first uses the first image; random draws one from the agent's deterministic RNG stream and is stable under --replay-check. The chosen index is logged as img_idx on the impression row.

social_graph.description: Agent-to-agent follow graph: comments carry author handles and follower counts, agents may follow_users, hot comments rank by followers, and each agent sees what the people it follows did yesterday. Off by default; enabling it changes prompt_sha.

heat_seed.description: Seeded social proof: posts are randomised plus/ctrl at publication on a derived stream; a plus post shows likes+k on its first display day only. Ranking and counters never see the seed, so exposure is identical across arms. focus_fund restricts randomisation to one fund's posts (others are 'na'). Off by default; off is byte-identical.

institutions.description: Institution adaptation: every period_days each org re-weights its I1/I2/I3 mix from the responses its posts drew (w_new = (1-eta)*w_old + eta*share, floored, renormalised); one inst event per org per period. Off by default; off is byte-identical.

regulation.description: Sell-side rules. short_term_redemption encodes CSRC 2017 (units held < days pay >= min_fee_rate); default off; the counterfactual fee is always logged on co rows as st_fee_cf.

dynamics.description: Belief, familiarity, affinity, and attention dynamics. Defaults live in config/engine_defaults.yaml.

fam_decay.description: Per-day decay of the familiarity exposure stock.

fam_threshold.description: Familiarity or affinity stock at which an organisation reaches exposure level 1; level 2 is reserved for an explicit follow.

lambda_attention.description: Retention of the per-fund attention stock: att_t = lambda_attention * att_{t-1} + exposure + beta_guba * z_guba.

beta_guba.description: Coefficient on the external abnormal-volume signal z_abnormal inside the attention adstock. Zero disables its contribution; negative values are allowed.

dca.description: Monthly dollar-cost-averaging ticket parameters. Defaults live in config/engine_defaults.yaml.

pct.description: Fraction of the agent's cash invested per DCA instalment. Default 0.02.

min_ticket.description: Minimum instalment in CNY; a smaller amount is skipped and counted in dca_skipped. Default 100.0.

initial_pnl.description: Optional opening-holding cost model. 'lookback' samples a cost date uniformly within the configured trading-day window. 'target' samples toward a configured opening P&L distribution and requires share_at_loss to be stated explicitly.

lookback_days_min.description: Lower end of the cost-date lookback in trading days; default 60 equals today's randint lower bound.

lookback_days_max.description: Upper end of the cost-date lookback in trading days; default 250 equals today's randint upper bound.

share_at_loss.description: Target share of opening holdings that sit at a loss. Read only when mode is 'target'.

tolerance.description: Absolute P&L tolerance accepted when scanning the lookback window for a cost date. Read only when mode is 'target'; a holding outside it is counted in initial_pnl_misses.

market.description: Optional benchmark series behind the agent view's index_5d field. When null, index_5d is omitted. A configured proxy must carry an explicit label, and only its returns are used.

benchmark_path.description: Path to a {"_meta": {...}, "series": {"YYYY-MM-DD": float}} file. index_5d is computed as v[t-1] / v[t-6] - 1, both operands at or before t-1 because look-ahead is the red line of invariant (a); a missing date leaves index_5d empty with no interpolation and no forward fill.

benchmark_label.description: Human-readable label shown in prompts and reports. It must disclose when the series is a proxy.

qdii_blocked.description: Optional per-date QDII purchase suspensions: {"YYYY-MM-DD": {"codes": [fund_code, ...]}}. A subscription into a listed fund on that date checks out as purchase_blocked. There is no default; callers must provide a calendar explicitly.

p_image.description: LEGACY, optional: image probability superseded by modality_arms (the TV arm); kept for backward compatibility. No longer required.

climate_margin.description: Margin |bullish - bearish| / total that a post's previous-day comment climate must clear before it is labelled bullish_majority or bearish_majority instead of mixed.

fit_band_narrow.description: feed.fit() narrow adjustment for the core-type term.

fit_band_wide.description: feed.fit() wide adjustment for the risk-latency term on an I2 post.

w_att.description: Weight on the agent's per-fund attention stock in the feed score, bounded by tanh like w_trust. At 0.0 attention has no effect; raising it together with dynamics.beta_guba enables the external-attention channel.

decision_failure_min_calls.description: Minimum number of decisions before decision_failure_halt is evaluated (a rate on <100 calls is noise); 0 = evaluate from the first call.

temperature.description: Optional (E9, default 0.3 in config/engine_defaults.yaml, equal to the agents/runtime.py TEMP constant it replaces). Sampling temperature sent to the provider; an experimental parameter, so it belongs in the validated config and in run_meta rather than in a module constant. The bound is the widest any supported provider accepts -- GLM itself takes (0, 1].

max_provider_attempts.description: Optional (E9, default 5 in config/engine_defaults.yaml, equal to the agents/runtime.py MAX_ATTEMPTS constant it replaces). PHYSICAL HTTP retry budget inside call_glm for one request. Distinct from max_attempts above, which is the macro re-ask switch at the decision level: same word, different mechanism, deliberately two keys.

rate_limit_cap_s.description: Optional (A1a, default 120 in config/engine_defaults.yaml). Upper bound, in seconds, on a single 429/RATE_LIMIT backoff sleep inside call_glm. Bounds each individual wait; the cumulative per-request budget is the sibling key rate_limit_max_wait_s.

rate_limit_max_wait_s.description: Optional (A1a, default 600 in config/engine_defaults.yaml). Cumulative upper bound, in seconds, on total rate-limit waiting across one call_glm request; only once this budget is exceeded is that attempt counted as failed (rate_limited) and handed to the retry ladder.

mock_options.description: MockLLM options; REQUIRED iff mock_llm is true (enforced by allOf below). A live (non-mock) run must not carry these mock-only fields.

channels.description: Only typed here; default values (all true except trend/direct) live in config/engine_defaults.yaml.
